facts.why: The Annexation of Puerto Rico is a hook and lateral from Rudy Zolteck to Junior, then a lateral from Junior to Jake Berman, who runs 99 yards for the touchdown. The ball does not go to Icebox.

facts.text: Icebox, the quarterback who is a girl
facts.why: Junior Floyd is the Giants' quarterback. Becky 'Icebox' O'Shea is the best player at tryouts and gets cut because she is a girl. She later suits up and stops Spike at the goal line. Printed on the second face as part of the 'On the big screen tonight' line.
facts.fix: Icebox, the girl the Cowboys cut

facts.text: Pass me the ball, then pass me the hot dogs. Icebox is starving after practice and nobody calls me small at dinner.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Becky's words, but I found no quote page for this film that I could open, and the plot page has no such line. Nobody calls Becky small in the plot I read, and she is not shown as a small player. Treat it as an invented quote.
facts.fix: The Cowboys cut me for being a girl. The Giants did not. Pass the hot dogs, then pass the ball.

facts.text: Becky the Icebox rallying the team
facts.why: Danny gives the speech that turns the game. Becky is cut from the Cowboys at tryouts for being a girl, then ends up on the Giants.
facts.fix: Becky the Icebox, cut by the Cowboys

facts.text: John Madden's pick, between the plays.
facts.why: Madden turns up on a bus to coach the kids. Nothing shows him picking any food.
Wikipedia and the script give Icebox as her nickname but never show how she earned it.
facts.fix: Becky's nickname is Icebox. Keep cool.
